output_text:
```python
import os
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
from azure.ai.formrecognizer import DocumentAnalysisClient

def normalize_expense(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    endpoint = config.get('endpoint') or os.environ.get('AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_ENDPOINT')
    key = config.get('key') or os.environ.get('AZURE_FORM_RECOGNIZER_KEY')
    client = DocumentAnalysisClient(endpoint, AzureKeyCredential(key))
    poller = client.begin_analyze_document("prebuilt-receipt", payload)
    raw_result = poller.result()
    doc = raw_result.documents[0]
    fields = doc.fields
    result = {
        "merchant_name": fields.get("MerchantName").content if fields.get("MerchantName") else None,
        "transaction_date": fields.get("TransactionDate").content if fields.get("TransactionDate") else None,
        "subtotal": fields.get("Subtotal").value if fields.get("Subtotal") else None,
        "tax": fields.get("Tax").value if fields.get("Tax") else None,
        "tip": fields.get("Tip").value if fields.get("Tip") else None,
        "total": fields.get("Total").value if fields.get("Total") else None,
        "items": [
            {
                "name": item.fields.get("Name").content if item.fields.get("Name") else None,
                "quantity": item.fields.get("Quantity").value if item.fields.get("Quantity") else None,
                "price": item.fields.get("Price").value if item.fields.get("Price") else None,
            }
            for item in (fields.get("Items").value or [])
        ]
    }
    return result
```
